newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end steady, reflects U.S. holiday.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end steady, reflects U.S. holiday.

text.p: 1630 GMT - Portuguese bonds ended calm in illiquid trade, reflecting the holiday in the U.S. Spreads against 10-year Bunds narrowed. Dealers said the market would remain buoyant early next week. *Sept 97 futures steady at 110.75 points *Feb 07 cash (OTC) 102.15 (102.20), yld 6.31 (6.31) *Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 71 bps vs 72 bps
Portuguese bonds ended calm in light trade influenced by the U.S. Independence Day holiday and dealers said bonds would remain buoyant next week.
They said expectations that favourable June inflation data would pave the way for further key rate cuts by the Bank of Portugal boosted optimism.
"Today was a day to forget because of a lack of interesting factors in the market," a dealer said.
Dealers said they expected yield spreads between 10-year bonds and Bunds to stand at between 60 and 70 basis points next week.
